findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_offers, search_agent_examples, get_ownership_check, get_vendor_answers, get_trust_facts, compare_ownership_checks · Private data: get_offers, get_vendor_answers, get_trust_facts, compare_ownership_checks, prepare_intake_link · Public sink: get_vendor_answers · Destructive: get_vendor_answers, get_trust_facts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_offers, search_agent_examples, get_ownership_check, get_vendor_answers, get_trust_facts, compare_ownership_checks · Private data: get_offers, get_vendor_answers, get_trust_facts, compare_ownership_checks, prepare_intake_link · Public sink: get_vendor_answers · Destructive: get_vendor_answers, get_trust_facts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
